definition: Controls designed to filter, authenticate, quarantine, or inspect inbound email.
include_when: Include malicious attachment screening, malicious link screening, DKIM, SPF, DMARC, quarantine services, secure email gateways, and external email tagging.
exclude_when: Exclude general phishing training unless the question is specifically about technical email filtering.

definition: Employee training or simulation activities designed to reduce phishing and cyber risk.
include_when: Include phishing training, phishing simulations, retraining after failures, and cybersecurity awareness training frequency.
exclude_when: Exclude technical email gateway, link screening, or attachment scanning controls.

definition: Use of MFA to secure access to systems, email, remote access, or privileged accounts.
include_when: Include MFA for remote access, VPN, RDP, webmail, email, privileged accounts, domain admin, or cloud administration.
exclude_when: Exclude general password policies unless MFA is explicitly mentioned.

definition: Controls governing passwords, password managers, PAM tools, least privilege, and administrator rights.
include_when: Include password managers, PAM, least privilege, local admin rights, privileged account controls, and service account password controls.
exclude_when: Exclude MFA unless the question is specifically about privileged password management.

definition: Controls for maintaining inventory and configuration awareness of systems.
include_when: Include asset discovery tools, asset databases, configuration management databases, and hardened baseline configurations.
exclude_when: Exclude vulnerability scanning unless the focus is maintaining asset or configuration records.

definition: Controls aimed at patching, segregating, or supporting unsupported or end-of-life software.
include_when: Include critical patching procedures, unsupported or end-of-life software management, segregation, and extended support.
exclude_when: Exclude general vulnerability scanning if no remediation or unsupported software control is referenced.

definition: Controls for backup frequency, offline storage, isolation, and recovery testing.
include_when: Include weekly backups, offline backups, isolated backups, backup recovery, and recovery testing.
exclude_when: Exclude incident response plans unless backup or recovery is explicitly referenced.

definition: Preparedness and planning for cyber incidents or system disruption.
include_when: Include incident response plans, business continuity plans, disruption response plans, and testing of those plans.
exclude_when: Exclude prior loss history unless the question directly asks about response planning.

definition: Technical protections on endpoints, remote access, and network traffic.
include_when: Include antivirus, EPP, EDR, MDR, NDR, firewalls, protective DNS, SMB blocking, RDP restrictions, and remote desktop controls.
exclude_when: Exclude vulnerability scanning unless the emphasis is on endpoint or network defense products.

definition: Monitoring, logging, detection, and SOC capabilities.
include_when: Include SOC, SIEM, abnormal behavior alerting, monitoring rules, 24/7 monitoring, and remediation authority.
exclude_when: Exclude general endpoint protection unless the emphasis is on monitoring or operations.

definition: Activities used to discover weaknesses in systems.
include_when: Include vulnerability scan coverage, scan frequency, scheduled scans, and security testing cadence.
exclude_when: Exclude patching unless the question focuses on scanning rather than remediation.

definition: Encryption and storage safeguards for sensitive data and devices.
include_when: Include encryption of sensitive data, portable devices, laptops, mobile devices, data at rest, data in transit, and secure storage.
exclude_when: Exclude general privacy compliance questions unless encryption or technical protection is explicit.

code: Funds Transfer and Social Engineering Controls
definition: Verification controls for ACH, wire, payroll, or banking-detail changes.
include_when: Include secondary confirmation, dual authentication, transfer validation, and banking change verification.
exclude_when: Exclude general MFA unless it is tied to funds transfer or account-change validation.

code: Data Inventory and Sensitive Data Exposure
definition: Questions quantifying or characterizing PII, PHI, PCI, records, or protected information exposure.
include_when: Include number of records, PHI/PII/PCI volume, payment card handling, and protected information storage or transmission.
exclude_when: Exclude encryption unless the focus is what data is held rather than how it is secured.

definition: Formal compliance or legal-governance questions relevant to cyber, privacy, or regulated data.
include_when: Include HIPAA, HITECH, PCI compliance, legal review of trademarks or domain names, and regulatory responsibilities.
exclude_when: Exclude content moderation unless it is framed as legal review or compliance.

definition: Procedures governing publication, takedown, infringement review, editorial controls, and third-party content.
include_when: Include takedown procedures, editorial controls, third-party content review, written client sign-off, infringement screening, and content complaint handling.
exclude_when: Exclude core cybersecurity controls such as MFA, backups, or endpoint protection.
